description_en: Queries the details of a namespace
description_zh: 调用DescribeNamespace接口查询命名空间详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun sae describe-namespace --namespace-id cn-beijing:test --name-space-short-id test --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeNamespace

parameters.help_en: The ID of the namespace. The information about the default namespace cannot be queried or modified. The default namespace cannot be deleted
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间ID。默认命名空间不可查询、更改或删除
parameters.name: namespace_id

parameters.help_en: The short ID of the namespace. You do not need to specify a region ID. The value of this parameter can be up to 20 characters in length and can contain only lowercase letters and digits
parameters.help_zh: 短版命名空间ID，不需要带上region；不超过20个字符，仅允许小写英文字母和数字
parameters.name: name_space_short_id

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code. Valid values:

2xx: The call was successful.

3xx: The call was redirected.

4xx: The call failed.

5xx: A server error occurred
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

EnableMicroRegistration.description_en:
Indicates whether the SAE built-in registry is enabled. Valid values:

true

false
EnableMicroRegistration.description_zh:
是否已启用SAE内置注册中心：
true
false

NameSpaceShortId.description_en: The short ID of the namespace

NamespaceId.description_en: The ID of the namespace. The information about the default namespace cannot be queried or modified. The default namespace cannot be deleted
NamespaceId.description_zh: 命名空间ID。默认命名空间不可查询、更改或删除

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code returned. Take note of the following rules:

The ErrorCode parameter is not returned if the request succeeds.

The ErrorCode parameter is returned if the request fails. For more information, see the Error codes section in this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码目录

Message.description_en:
The additional information that is returned. Valid values:

success: If the call is successful, success is returned.

An error code: If the call fails, an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the information about the namespace was queried successfully. Valid values:

true: The information was queried.

false: The image failed to be found
Success.description_zh:
查询命名空间信息是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：查询成功。
false：查询失败

TraceId.description_en: The trace ID that is used to query the details of the request
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息
